expectedFormat.title: Sales / trading analysis — XLSX
expectedFormat.intro: One row per SKU-channel-period line. Headers below show the column names the parser recognizes (Romanian and English variants both accepted).
expectedFormat.required: Only <c1>Denumire produs</c1> and <c2>NIV</c2> are required overall;
expectedFormat.optional: <c1>Inventory value</c1> + <c2>COGS</c2> are optional but unlock per-SKU <c3>DIO</c3>;
expectedFormat.rollup: the company-level <c1>CCC</c1> roll-up additionally uses the period trial balance for DSO / DPO.
expectedFormat.exampleCaption: Anonymized example — match these columns; fictional data.
expectedFormat.exampleFooter: Placeholder rows for illustration only — replace with your real export. The third row deliberately omits <c1>Inventory value</c1> & <c2>COGS</c2> to demonstrate the "DIO not available" rendering: rows without both inputs show "—", never 0, and are excluded from the company DIO aggregate.

workingCapital.title: Working-capital roll-up
workingCapital.subtitle: Company DIO · DSO · DPO · CCC
workingCapital.explainer: DIO from uploaded SKU inventory & COGS, covered rows only. DSO / DPO from the period's trial-balance context. CCC is a company roll-up, not per-SKU.
workingCapital.notAvailableReason: Inventory / COGS not provided on any SKU
workingCapital.addColumnsHint: Add Inventory value and COGS columns to the upload to compute DIO.
workingCapital.cccExplain: CCC is computed only when DIO, DSO and DPO are all available.
workingCapital.exclusionNote: Rows without inventory + COGS show DIO as "—" in the table above and are excluded from the company DIO aggregate (never treated as zero).

footnote.flag: Two things worth flagging given the structure:

approximated.heading: Cash flow is approximated
approximated.body: This is a single-period upload, so working-capital movements and financing detail can't be computed exactly. The reconciliation plug absorbs unmodeled accounts. For exact figures, upload the prior year trial balance as well.
